blocks.zh: 第四章：文件管理
blocks.en: Chapter 4: Documentation

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解 GDP 文件管理系統的核心原則：文件如何防止口頭傳遞錯誤，並追溯藥品流通的各項作業
blocks.en: Understand the core principle of the GDP documentation system: how documents prevent errors from verbal instructions and allow the operations involved in medicinal product distribution to be traced

blocks.zh: 掌握文件（Documentation）的定義範疇：書面程序、指示、合約、記錄、資料，含紙本與電子形式
blocks.en: Grasp the scope of "documentation": written procedures, instructions, contracts, records and data, in paper or electronic form

blocks.zh: 熟悉文件核准、簽署、修訂及版本控制的規範要求
blocks.en: Know the requirements for document approval, signing, revision and version control

blocks.zh: 理解文件保存期限（至少 5 年）及個人資料保護的義務
blocks.en: Understand the retention period for documents (at least 5 years) and the obligation to protect personal data

blocks.zh: 識別交易記錄的必要欄位：日期、產品名稱、數量、供應商/客戶資訊、批號、到期日
blocks.en: Identify the required fields of a transaction record: date, product name, quantity, supplier/customer details, batch number and expiry date

blocks.zh: 4.1 原則 & 4.2.1–4.2.4 文件管理基礎 | Principle & Documentation Basics
blocks.en: 4.1 Principle & 4.2.1–4.2.4 Documentation Basics

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念 文件管理的三大功能
blocks.en: Key Concept: The Three Functions of Documentation

blocks.zh: GDP 的文件管理系統服務三個核心功能：
blocks.en: The GDP documentation system serves three core functions:

blocks.zh: 防錯（Prevention）：以書面取代口頭指示，消除因溝通失誤導致的錯誤。藥品配送涉及多個環節（供應商、倉儲、運輸、客戶），每個移交點都是潛在的溝通風險點。
blocks.en: Prevention: Written instructions replace verbal ones, eliminating errors caused by miscommunication. Medicinal product distribution involves many links (supplier, warehouse, transport, customer), and every handover point is a potential communication risk.

blocks.zh: 追溯（Traceability）：每項作業都有記錄，當發生品質事件時，可以「倒帶」還原整個配送過程。這正是藥品召回（recall）作業的基礎。
blocks.en: Traceability: Every operation is recorded, so when a quality event occurs the whole distribution process can be "rewound" and reconstructed. This is the foundation of recall operations.

blocks.zh: 問責（Accountability）：文件需由指定人員核准並簽署，確保每個決策都有明確的責任歸屬。
blocks.en: Accountability: Documents must be approved and signed by designated persons, so that every decision has a clearly assigned owner.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 航空公司飛行日誌
blocks.en: Analogy: The Airline Flight Log

blocks.zh: 想像航空公司的飛行日誌（Flight Log）：每次飛行的每個動作都需即時記錄——起飛時間、天氣、異常事件、燃油消耗。如果事後才補記，細節可能已失真。
blocks.en: Think of an airline flight log: every action on every flight must be recorded in real time (takeoff time, weather, abnormal events, fuel consumption). If entries are added afterwards, the details may already be distorted.

blocks.zh: GDP 文件管理的「當下記錄（records should be made at the time each operation is undertaken）」原則完全相同：不能事後補寫，因為記憶會美化或模糊真實發生的狀況。這也是 GMP 查廠時，稽核員最重視的問題之一。
blocks.en: The GDP principle of contemporaneous recording (records should be made at the time each operation is undertaken) is exactly the same: entries cannot be written up later, because memory embellishes or blurs what really happened. This is also one of the issues auditors care about most during GMP inspections.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 個人資料保護（4.2.2）
blocks.en: Key Point: Protection of Personal Data (4.2.2)

blocks.zh: 在 Taiwan CDMO 的倉庫作業中，這一條款常被忽略。涉及個人資料的文件包括：員工操作記錄（含姓名）、客訴記錄（含投訴人資訊）、供應商聯絡人資料。
blocks.en: In warehouse operations at Taiwan CDMOs, this clause is often overlooked. Documents containing personal data include employee operation records (with names), complaint records (with complainant details) and supplier contact information.

blocks.zh: 依台灣《個人資料保護法》（PDPA），這些資料必須有明確的蒐集目的，且保存期限不應超出必要範圍。GDP 特別指出，當儲存目的消失後，個人資料應予「刪除或匿名化（deleted or anonymised）」。請與法遵部門確認合規措施。
blocks.en: Under Taiwan's Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA), such data must be collected for a clear purpose, and the retention period should not exceed what is necessary. GDP specifically states that once the purpose of storage no longer exists, personal data should be "deleted or anonymised". Confirm the compliance measures with your legal and compliance department.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 4.2.1 說文件必須「readily available/retrievable（隨時可取得）」，在電子系統中，這需要什麼具體措施來確保？（提示：考慮系統備份、帳號存取權限、離線閱讀等）
blocks.en: 4.2.1 states that documents must be "readily available/retrievable". For electronic systems, what concrete measures are needed to ensure this? (Hint: consider system backup, account access rights, offline reading, etc.)

blocks.zh: 文件「不得手寫」但「必要時需留空間」，這兩個要求似乎矛盾，你如何在實務設計中平衡？（提示：哪些欄位通常是手寫填入的？）
blocks.en: Documents should "not be handwritten", yet "sufficient space should be provided" where entries are required. These two requirements seem contradictory; how would you balance them in practical document design? (Hint: which fields are usually filled in by hand?)

blocks.zh: 4.2.3 要求文件使用「personnel 能理解的語言」，在台灣多語言倉儲作業（本地員工 + 外籍勞工）中，這對 SOP 撰寫有什麼影響？
blocks.en: 4.2.3 requires documents to use language "understood by personnel". In multilingual warehouse operations in Taiwan (local staff plus foreign workers), what does this mean for SOP writing?

blocks.zh: 4.2.5–4.2.8 文件變更管理與版本控制 | Change Control & Version Management
blocks.en: 4.2.5–4.2.8 Document Change Control & Version Management

blocks.zh: 核心概念 文件修改的「單線劃除」原則
blocks.en: Key Concept: The "Single-Line Strike-Through" Principle for Document Amendments

blocks.zh: 4.2.5 的核心要求是：修改不能抹去原始資訊。正確做法是「單線劃除原文，旁邊簽名並標日期，必要時說明原因」。
blocks.en: The core requirement of 4.2.5 is that an amendment must not obscure the original information. The correct practice is to strike through the original entry with a single line, then sign and date next to it and, where necessary, state the reason.

blocks.zh: 常見違規行為：
blocks.en: Common non-compliant practices:

blocks.zh: 用立可白（correction fluid）覆蓋原文 — 違規，原文不可辨讀
blocks.en: Covering the original entry with correction fluid: non-compliant, the original is no longer legible

blocks.zh: 用黑色簽字筆塗黑原文 — 違規，原文不可辨讀
blocks.en: Blacking out the original entry with a black marker: non-compliant, the original is no longer legible

blocks.zh: 用雙線或花體覆蓋 — 違規，原文不可辨讀
blocks.en: Overwriting with double lines or scribbles: non-compliant, the original is no longer legible

blocks.zh: 正確做法：單線（single line through）劃除，確保原文仍可讀取，旁邊簽名 + 日期，複雜修改附上原因說明。
blocks.en: Correct practice: strike through with a single line so the original remains legible, sign and date alongside, and for complex changes add an explanation of the reason.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 法庭文件的公證修改
blocks.en: Analogy: Notarised Amendments to Legal Documents

blocks.zh: 想像一份法律合約：如果你要修改某個金額，你不能塗黑它——你需要劃掉，在旁邊寫上正確數字，然後雙方在更改處初簽（initial）確認。
blocks.en: Imagine a legal contract: if you need to change an amount, you cannot black it out. You cross it out, write the correct figure beside it, and both parties initial the change to confirm it.

blocks.zh: GDP 文件修改的邏輯完全一樣：「被劃掉的原文」就像「刪除但仍可讀的舊版條款」，它證明文件的完整性從未被操控過。這在應對稽核（audit）或法律爭議時尤為重要。
blocks.en: The logic for GDP document amendments is exactly the same: the "struck-through original" is like a "deleted but still legible old clause", and it proves that the integrity of the document has never been tampered with. This is especially important when responding to audits or legal disputes.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 版本控制的六個管理要素（4.2.8）
blocks.en: Key Point: The Six Elements of Version Control (4.2.8)

blocks.zh: 4.2.8 包含完整的版本控制循環，六個要素缺一不可：
blocks.en: 4.2.8 contains a complete version control cycle, and all six elements are indispensable:

blocks.zh: 明確標題與目的（Title & Purpose） — 員工拿到文件就知道是什麼
blocks.en: Clear title and purpose (Title & Purpose): staff know what a document is as soon as they pick it up

blocks.zh: 定期審查（Regular Review） — 多久審查一次？需在 SOP 中規定
blocks.en: Regular review (Regular Review): how often is a document reviewed? This must be defined in an SOP

blocks.zh: 版本號管理（Version Control） — 如 v1.0, v1.1, v2.0
blocks.en: Version number management (Version Control): for example v1.0, v1.1, v2.0

blocks.zh: 防止誤用舊版（Prevent superseded use） — 需有系統機制，非僅靠人員記憶
blocks.en: Preventing use of superseded versions (Prevent superseded use): a system mechanism is needed, not just reliance on people's memory

blocks.zh: 舊版回收（Remove from workstations） — 現場不得留存已廢止版本
blocks.en: Retrieval of old versions (Remove from workstations): no obsolete versions may remain on the floor

blocks.zh: 舊版封存（Archive superseded） — 留作歷史追溯，但標明「已廢止」
blocks.en: Archiving of old versions (Archive superseded): kept for historical traceability, but clearly marked "superseded"

blocks.zh: 實務應用 電子文件管理系統（EDMS）的 GDP 合規設計
blocks.en: Practical Application: GDP-Compliant Design of an Electronic Document Management System (EDMS)

blocks.zh: 在 Taiwan CDMO 倉庫，許多公司使用電子化 SOP 系統（如 Veeva Vault、Master Control 或自建系統）。根據 4.2.8，系統必須具備：
blocks.en: In warehouses at Taiwan CDMOs, many companies use electronic SOP systems (such as Veeva Vault, Master Control or in-house systems). According to 4.2.8, the system must provide:

blocks.zh: 當新版本發布時，舊版本自動鎖定（不可列印、不可存取），確保現場員工只能看到有效版本
blocks.en: When a new version is released, the old version is locked automatically (cannot be printed or accessed), so that floor staff can only see the effective version

blocks.zh: 版本歷史存檔（Archive），稽核員可隨時查看歷史版本
blocks.en: A version history archive, so that auditors can review historical versions at any time

blocks.zh: 21 CFR Part 11（電子記錄/簽章）合規，確保電子簽名具有法律效力
blocks.en: Compliance with 21 CFR Part 11 (electronic records/signatures), ensuring electronic signatures are legally valid

blocks.zh: 使用者角色權限（Role-based access），確保 4.2.7「每個員工可存取其作業所需文件」
blocks.en: Role-based access, ensuring that, as 4.2.7 requires, each employee can access the documents needed for their tasks

blocks.zh: 4.2.6 規定保存至少 5 年，但台灣《藥事法》可能有不同規定。如果本地法律要求 10 年，你應採用哪個標準？（提示：GDP 說「國家法規優先，但至少 5 年」，這句話的邏輯是什麼？）
blocks.en: 4.2.6 requires retention for at least 5 years, but Taiwan's Pharmaceutical Affairs Act may specify differently. If local law requires 10 years, which standard should you adopt? (Hint: GDP says "national legislation takes precedence, but at least 5 years"; what is the logic of this statement?)

blocks.zh: 4.2.8 要求防止「inadvertent use（無意間使用）」舊版文件，如果你的倉庫現場使用紙本 SOP，你設計哪些實體管控措施？
blocks.en: 4.2.8 requires preventing "inadvertent use" of superseded documents. If your warehouse floor uses paper SOPs, what physical controls would you design?

blocks.zh: 定期審查（regular review）的頻率在 PE 011-1 中沒有明確規定，你會如何在公司 SOP 中定義這個頻率？哪些文件可以拉長審查週期，哪些必須更頻繁？
blocks.en: PE 011-1 does not specify the frequency of regular review. How would you define it in your company SOP? Which documents can have a longer review cycle, and which must be reviewed more frequently?

blocks.zh: 4.2.9 交易記錄的必要欄位 | Mandatory Transaction Record Fields
blocks.en: 4.2.9 Mandatory Transaction Record Fields

blocks.zh: date（日期）
blocks.en: date

blocks.zh: name of the medicinal product（藥品名稱）
blocks.en: name of the medicinal product

blocks.zh: quantity received, supplied（接收/供應數量）
blocks.en: quantity received, supplied

blocks.zh: name and address of the supplier, customer, or consignee, as appropriate（供應商、客戶或收貨人名稱及地址）
blocks.en: name and address of the supplier, customer, or consignee, as appropriate

blocks.zh: batch number, expiry date, as required by national legislation（批號、到期日，依國家法規要求）
blocks.en: batch number, expiry date, as required by national legislation

blocks.zh: 核心概念 交易記錄的「最低欄位」清單
blocks.en: Key Concept: The Minimum Field List for Transaction Records

blocks.zh: 4.2.9 清楚定義六個必要欄位。這些欄位直接對應藥品召回（recall）作業的需要：
blocks.en: 4.2.9 clearly defines six required fields. They map directly to what recall operations need:

blocks.zh: 日期 — 建立時間軸，確認問題批次的流通時間窗口
blocks.en: Date: establishes the timeline and confirms the distribution window of the affected batch

blocks.zh: 藥品名稱 — 識別問題產品品項
blocks.en: Name of medicinal product: identifies the affected product

blocks.zh: 數量 — 確認問題批次的流通規模
blocks.en: Quantity: confirms the scale of distribution of the affected batch

blocks.zh: 供應商/客戶/收貨人名稱地址 — 定義召回通知的對象清單
blocks.en: Name and address of supplier/customer/consignee: defines the notification list for a recall

blocks.zh: 批號 — 精確識別需召回的批次
blocks.en: Batch number: precisely identifies the batches to be recalled

blocks.zh: 到期日 — 輔助確認問題範圍
blocks.en: Expiry date: helps confirm the scope of the problem

blocks.zh: 一旦以上任一欄位缺失，召回作業就會出現盲點，無法確認問題藥品是否已全數回收。
blocks.en: If any one of these fields is missing, the recall will have blind spots, and it cannot be confirmed whether all affected product has been retrieved.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 超市條碼系統的逆向追溯
blocks.en: Analogy: Reverse Tracing in a Supermarket Barcode System

blocks.zh: 2011 年台灣塑化劑事件後，食品主管機關要求所有通路可在 24 小時內下架所有問題品項。這之所以可能，是因為超市的進貨系統記錄了「哪一批貨、何時入庫、賣給哪個門市」的完整資訊。
blocks.en: After the 2011 plasticizer incident in Taiwan, the food authority required all retail channels to remove every affected item from sale within 24 hours. This was possible because supermarket receiving systems recorded which lot arrived, when it was received and which store it was sold to.

blocks.zh: 藥品的 GDP 交易記錄，功能完全相同。批號（batch number）是關鍵連結，它是一個批次的「指紋」，讓整個供應鏈可以「順藤摸瓜」——從製造商到批發商到醫院，每一個環節都有記錄可查。
blocks.en: GDP transaction records for medicinal products work in exactly the same way. The batch number is the key link: it is the "fingerprint" of a batch, letting the whole supply chain trace the product step by step from manufacturer to wholesaler to hospital, with a record available at every link.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 「contemporaneously（當下同步）」的法律意涵
blocks.en: Key Point: The Legal Implications of "Contemporaneously"

blocks.zh: 4.2.9 的最後一句話極為重要：記錄必須當下（contemporaneously）完成，而非事後補記。
blocks.en: The last sentence of 4.2.9 is extremely important: records must be made contemporaneously, not written up afterwards.

blocks.zh: 在稽核中，「補記」的文件往往可以被識別：筆跡墨水顏色、筆迹流暢度（緊張時手寫與正常時不同）、電子記錄的後設資料（metadata，如修改時間戳記）都是常見的鑑別方式。
blocks.en: In audits, documents that were back-filled can often be identified: ink colour, fluency of handwriting (handwriting under stress differs from normal) and metadata of electronic records (such as modification timestamps) are common ways to detect it.

blocks.zh: 手寫記錄另有三個額外要求：清晰（clear）、易讀（legible）、不可消除（indelible）。鉛筆或可消除墨水筆均不符合規定，必須使用藍色或黑色簽字筆（不可消除）。
blocks.en: Handwritten records have three further requirements: they must be clear, legible and indelible. Pencil or erasable ink pens are not acceptable; blue or black ink pens (indelible) must be used.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 CDMO 倉庫的電子批次記錄設計
blocks.en: Practical Application: Electronic Record Design for a CDMO Warehouse

blocks.zh: 在無菌 CDMO 的進出貨作業中，4.2.9 的「交易記錄」通常由 WMS（倉庫管理系統，Warehouse Management System）自動生成。關鍵設計要點：
blocks.en: In goods receipt and dispatch at a sterile CDMO, the "transaction records" of 4.2.9 are usually generated automatically by the WMS (Warehouse Management System). Key design points:

blocks.zh: WMS 應在物料掃描入庫/出庫時自動記錄時間戳記，確保「contemporaneously」要求
blocks.en: The WMS should automatically record a timestamp when materials are scanned in or out, ensuring the "contemporaneously" requirement is met

blocks.zh: 批號（Lot Number）與有效期（Expiry Date）需強制輸入，不可留空
blocks.en: Lot number and expiry date must be mandatory entries and cannot be left blank

blocks.zh: 供應商地址應連結至已合格供應商主檔（Approved Vendor List），避免手動輸入錯誤
blocks.en: Supplier addresses should be linked to the Approved Vendor List master data to avoid manual entry errors

blocks.zh: 電子記錄需符合 21 CFR Part 11（若出口美國市場）或 PIC/S Annex 11（若對應 EU 法規）的要求
blocks.en: Electronic records must meet the requirements of 21 CFR Part 11 (if exporting to the US market) or PIC/S Annex 11 (if aligning with EU regulations)

blocks.zh: 4.2.9 說「as required by national legislation（依國家法規要求）」，表示批號和到期日並非所有國家都是強制性的。但從藥品安全角度，你認為哪些情況下這兩個欄位是絕對必要的？
blocks.en: 4.2.9 says "as required by national legislation", which means batch number and expiry date are not mandatory in every country. From a medicinal product safety perspective, in which situations do you consider these two fields absolutely necessary?

blocks.zh: 如果你的公司正在設計新的 WMS 系統，4.2.9 的六個必要欄位對應到哪些 WMS 的必填欄位（mandatory fields）？有沒有 GDP 沒有要求、但你建議加入的欄位？
blocks.en: If your company is designing a new WMS, which mandatory fields in the WMS correspond to the six required fields of 4.2.9? Are there fields that GDP does not require but you would recommend adding?

blocks.zh: 一份供應商發票（purchase invoice）包含所有 4.2.9 要求的欄位，是否可以直接作為 GDP 記錄使用，還是需要額外的內部格式？
blocks.en: If a supplier purchase invoice contains all the fields required by 4.2.9, can it be used directly as the GDP record, or is an additional internal format needed?

blocks.zh: 本章重點總結 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 文件是品質系統的骨幹：書面文件防止口頭錯誤，追溯所有配送作業，並為責任歸屬提供依據（4.1）。
blocks.en: Documentation is the backbone of the quality system: written documents prevent verbal errors, trace all distribution operations and provide the basis for accountability (4.1).

blocks.zh: 文件的四大核准要素（4.2.4）：核准（approved）、簽名（signed）、日期（dated）、由指定人員（designated persons）執行。
blocks.en: Four approval elements for documents (4.2.4): approved, signed, dated, and performed by designated persons.

blocks.zh: 修改規則（4.2.5）：單線劃除，保留原文可讀，旁邊簽名 + 日期，必要時說明原因。禁止使用立可白或塗黑。
blocks.en: Amendment rule (4.2.5): strike through with a single line, keep the original legible, sign and date alongside, and state the reason where necessary. Correction fluid and blacking out are prohibited.

blocks.zh: 保存期限（4.2.6）：依國家法規，但最短 5 年；個人資料一旦不再必要應立即刪除或匿名化。
blocks.en: Retention period (4.2.6): per national legislation, but at least 5 years; personal data must be deleted or anonymised as soon as it is no longer necessary.

blocks.zh: 版本控制（4.2.8）：系統必須防止舊版被誤用，現場不得留存已廢止版本，舊版歸檔保存。
blocks.en: Version control (4.2.8): the system must prevent superseded versions from being used by mistake, obsolete versions must not remain on the floor, and old versions are archived.

blocks.zh: 交易記錄六要素（4.2.9）：日期 / 藥品名稱 / 數量 / 供應商或客戶資訊 / 批號 / 到期日；記錄必須當下完成。
blocks.en: Six elements of transaction records (4.2.9): date / product name / quantity / supplier or customer details / batch number / expiry date; records must be made contemporaneously.
